WITH track_data AS (
  SELECT 
    m.Name as MediaTypeName,
    CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / t.Milliseconds as bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
),
media_type_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeName,
    AVG(bytes_per_ms) as avg_bytes_per_ms
  FROM track_data
  GROUP BY MediaTypeName
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) as overall_avg
  FROM media_type_averages
)
SELECT 
  mta.MediaTypeName,
  mta.avg_bytes_per_ms as average,
  mta.avg_bytes_per_ms - oa.overall_avg as above_overall
FROM media_type_averages mta
CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
WHERE mta.avg_bytes_per_ms > oa.overall_avg
ORDER BY mta.MediaTypeName;
